brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry reported that eight Palestinians were killed and 26 others wounded in Israeli attacks across the Strip on Wednesday, according to Middle East Eye. The strikes added to the cumulative Palestinian death toll in Gaza, though the ministry did not specify the total figure in the available summary.

The attacks occurred across multiple locations throughout the territory. No further details about the specific sites or circumstances of the strikes were provided.

title: Eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza Strip
